method: Rehash complete source ZIP manifests and payloads; compare exact member sets and content hashes; rehash each new image permission receipt against inner source ZIP, outer GitHub artifact ZIP, extracted CI evidence file and reviewed CI receipt.

preserved_nonpassing_history.scope: Initial extra reviewer incorrectly required generated evidence to equal historical Git evidence; failed invocation remains retained separately.

limitations: The 213 refreshed historical evidence members are generated CI results, explicitly compared and recorded; they are not counted as mismatched product source.
Generated CI evidence is distinct from frozen local source evidence and from local installation VM acceptance.
No source ZIP bytes were changed and no GitHub write or rerun was initiated.
relative_path_context: archive_path is relative to the frozen source worktree; extracted_path is relative to the read-only CI collector output root.
